summary: On-prem KR primary cell stand-up + OCI KR secondary cell provisioning + M2 directive-side close + M3 entry. ADR-0121 (k8s stack), ADR-0120 (Rust-first tooling + paired uninstall), full infra/onprem/ tree with hardening + cleanup + security + paired uninstalls, infra/oci/ (31 tofu-managed resources), infra/cloudflare/ (tunnel + DNS), PR #10 rebased.

F1_linus.narrative: Each install script is one composable step with a paired uninstall. No magic; readable bash. Rust migration deferred to ADR-0120 Phase B as a separate ChangeSet.
F1_linus.no_special_cases: Debian 13 nftables / kube-proxy regression is captured in 2 places (kubeadm/install.sh + post-install/kube-proxy-iptables-mode.yaml) with explicit comments; not a special case, a documented workaround with a re-visit trigger.

F2_hyperscaler.narrative: Versions pinned to current-LTS-or-supported per upstream EOL matrices: containerd 2.3.0 (first annual LTS), kubeadm 1.35 (N-1 of 3-version support window), Istio 1.29.2 (current supported), OpenBao 2.5.3 (latest), OpenTofu 1.12.0 (latest).

F3_adversarial.narrative: Secrets-handling reviewed: ~/.oci/config 0600, OpenBao Shamir 5/3 unseal keys never written to repo, Cloudflare tunnel token redacted in diagnose output, security scanner redacts (cfut_*, ghp_*, sk-ant-*, AKIA*, JWT, Bearer, PEM, hex≥40).

F4_ergonomic.narrative: Single-command bring-up: `sudo bash infra/onprem/setup.sh`. Single-command diagnose: `bash infra/onprem/diagnose.sh`. Single-command teardown: `sudo bash infra/onprem/uninstall-all.sh`. Idempotent throughout.

F5_quality.narrative: Per ADR-0121 §test plan: `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` 0; `cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --no-fail-fast` 2683/2683 0; `cargo deny check` 0; `oya verify` 44/44 lanes 0. Diagnose verdict HEALTHY across 11 sections.

F6_alternatives.narrative: ADR-0121 §rejected explicitly considers k3s, k0s, MicroK8s, Talos for k8s; explains why kubeadm wins for the primary cell. ADR-0120 §rejected covers stay-in-shell, Ansible/Chef/Puppet, per-component crates.

F7_security.narrative: Weekly trivy (fs + rootfs + k8s) + gitleaks (repo + agent state + transient + auth + histories) + debsecan + cargo-audit + unattended-upgrades. Audit-chain emits EVT-SECURITY-SCAN per run. Permission audit warns on auth files not 0600/0700.

F8_performance.narrative: Foundry workspace-shell: 100 sequential 200/200 in 453ms; 50 parallel wall 27ms (per-request 100µs-7ms); SIGTERM graceful shutdown 1ms. k8s pod startup latency observed normal.

F9_compliance.narrative: ADR-0043 §KR-cell HSM-auto-unseal deferred to Wave 3 (file storage + Shamir for stage-0); KCMVP/FIPS 140-3 not yet validated because HSM partition not yet provisioned. Documented in OpenBao Wave-1 evidence.

F10_reversibility.narrative: ADR-0120 Rule 2: every install paired with uninstall. Top-level `uninstall-all.sh` reverses `setup.sh` in dependency order. Idempotent. PURGE=1 flag wipes user-data; default preserves it.

F11_observability.narrative: diagnose.sh 11-section health report. Audit-chain on ZFS (/srv/oyatie/audit-chain/{openbao-audit,security-scan-events}.jsonl). Cloudflare tunnel = full HSTS + cf-ray + HTTP/2. Istio Envoy access logs available cluster-side.

F13_migration.narrative: M2 directive-side close + spec-side partial close (OCI ARM64 Stage-0 deploy still pending A1 capacity). M3 entry gate passed; IP-001 ready to claim. PR #10 (ADR-0116 grit/rtk/icm/vox retirement) rebased + pushed; auto-merge armed on review approval.

M1_challenge_assumption.narrative: Challenged: is k3s fine for primary cell? → No, OKE parity matters; chose kubeadm. Is Envoy/Istio really needed pre-M3? → User pulled it forward; we delivered. Is per-script shell the right tooling long-term? → No (ADR-0120); Rust migration is the plan.

M2_zoomed_out_fit.narrative: Fits the masterplan: M2 substrate substrate-ready, M3 cloud foundations ready to claim with both KMS adapter backends live (OpenBao on-prem + OCI KMS in cloud). On-prem KR primary cell pairs with OCI KR secondary cell per ADR-0043.
